title: HashHub Lending rights and obligations transfer to SBI Digital Finance
description: A company split changed the HashHub Lending service provider from HashHub Inc. to newly established SBI Digital Finance Inc. effective 2024-04-01, with HashHub Lending-related contractual rights and obligations transferred to the new company and no customer balance-migration action required according to the first-party notice.
notes: This is a first-party documented operator and contractual-counterparty transition, not an acquisition, shutdown, loss event or evidence of customer impairment.
